ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fallen; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic gothic sound is less appealing right now than the heavier albums in my recent listening.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: St. Anger Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Heavy enough, but its raw sound is less tempting than the progressive and melodic metal I want today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Thirteenth Step; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After 10.000 Days, I would choose this for its atmospheric sound and Maynard's vocals.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: City of Evil Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Advance And Vanquish makes its fast riffs and melodic guitar work an appealing choice today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: L.D. 50 Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its heavy grooves fit my listening, but I would prioritize the Tool and Disturbed albums this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Believe Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Having recently listened to Ten Thousand Fists, I would try more of Disturbed's heavy, melodic sound.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Sing The Sorrow; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its darker melodic rock fits part of my history, but I am choosing heavier music today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Lateralus; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: 10.000 Days leaves me wanting more of Tool's intricate rhythms and immersive songs; this is my first choice.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Mezmerize Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The energetic riffs appeal, but I would save its abrupt stylistic shifts for another session.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Meteora; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic heaviness suits some of my listening, but Tool and Disturbed interest me more right now.
